source.title: Bitcoin Dumps as Democrats Take Congress! Now What?
source.description:
Bitcoin dumps to $75,000 as Democrats take control of Congress, the AI stock market bubble cracks, and fears of another massive government bailout grow. Is this Bitcoin crash the beginning of a larger financial crisis, or will Washington respond with more Federal Reserve liquidity, money printing, and inflation? From Trump's divided government and America's exploding national debt to a shocking banking crisis in Paraguay, we examine what comes next for Bitcoin, financial markets, and your money.
